name: Diarmait, king of Tara

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Diarmait was an Irish hero. Many Irish heroes bore this name. Diarmait served as King of Tara. He played a minor role in the tale of his wife BECFOLA. Becfola was unhappy with Diarmait. She desired his foster son CRIMTHANN. Crimthann disappointed her. Becfola then traveled to the OTHERWORLD. She went with the fairy king FLANN ua Fedach.
objective: Diarmait was one of several Irish heroes of that name. He served as King of Tara.
key_results: BECFOLA desired Diarmait's foster son CRIMTHANN.
Becfola left with the fairy king FLANN ua Fedach for the OTHERWORLD.
